recipes.name: Apple and peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple into rounds.
Spread with peanut butter.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with greens
steps: Heat oven to 200C; potatoes 25 min in the oil.
Add salmon and greens to the tray; 12 min more.
Squeeze lemon over.

recipes.name: Beef chili con carne
steps: Brown the mince; drain excess fat.
Soften onion and garlic; add spices.
Add tomatoes and beans; simmer 30 min.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Beef lettuce cups
steps: Brown the beef with garlic and ginger.
Season with soy; add grated carrot.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Beef and root vegetable stew
steps: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften onion; paste and herbs in.
Everything in a pot with stock and 500 ml water; 2 h low.
Potatoes in for the last 40 min.

recipes.name: Black bean burrito bowl
steps: Cook rice; warm beans with cumin and paprika.
Char the corn in a dry pan.
Bowl with avocado, lettuce, lime.

recipes.name: Caprese salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Layer with basil.
Dress with oil and balsamic.

recipes.name: Chia almond pudding
steps: Whisk chia into the milk with maple.
Rest 15 min, whisk again, chill overnight.
Top with almonds and strawberries.

recipes.name: Chicken quinoa bowl
steps: Roast the chicken at 200C for 20 min; rest and slice.
Simmer quinoa 15 min.
Steam broccoli; char the pepper.
Bowl it all with lemon and olive oil.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices 30 min.
Grill hot until charred.
Sauce: onion, garlic, ginger, tomato paste, passata; 15 min.
Fold in cream and chicken; serve over basmati.

recipes.name: Chickpea and tuna salad
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Toss everything together.
Dress with lemon and olive oil.

recipes.name: Chili sin carne
steps: Soften onion, garlic, jalapeño; toast the spices.
Add tomatoes and beans; simmer 20 min.
Stir in corn.
Serve over brown rice.

recipes.name: Cod with tomato and olives
steps: Parboil sliced potatoes 8 min; layer in a dish.
Tomatoes, olives, capers, oil over.
Cod on top; bake 25 min at 200C.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with pineapple
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Pineapple on top; black pepper if you like.

recipes.name: Cumin lentil soup
steps: Sweat carrot and celery in oil with cumin.
Add lentils and stock; simmer 30 min.
Blend half the pot for body; finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Dark chocolate and almonds
steps: Portion both into two bowls.
Slow, not gone.

recipes.name: Sea salt edamame
steps: Boil the edamame 4 min.
Drain; salt generously.

recipes.name: Veggie egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice and cool it.
Scramble the eggs; set aside.
Stir-fry carrot and peas; add rice, soy, sesame oil; fold in egg.

recipes.name: Eggs on spinach toast
steps: Butter the toast; wilt the spinach in the same pan.
Poach the eggs 3 min.
Stack spinach, eggs and black pepper on the toast.

recipes.name: Mediterranean falafel wrap
steps: Blitz chickpeas, parsley, garlic, cumin; form 8 balls.
Shallow-fry until crisp.
Warm pitas; fill with falafel, cucumber and yogurt.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken and potatoes
steps: Oven 200C. Everything in a roasting tin with oil, lemon, oregano.
Roast 45 min, turning the potatoes once.
Rest 5 min; pan juices over.

recipes.name: Greek salad
steps: Chunky chop the vegetables.
Feta and olives over; oregano and oil.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt berry bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries and almonds.
Drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Hummus with veg sticks
steps: Blitz chickpeas, tahini, lemon, cumin with a splash of water.
Cut the veg into sticks.
Dip.

recipes.name: Herby chicken rice salad
steps: Roast the chicken 22 min at 200C; cool, slice.
Cook the rice; cool.
Toss with cucumber, tomatoes, mint; lemon and oil over.

recipes.name: Eggs and spinach on corn cakes
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil.
Fry the eggs.
Stack on the corn cakes; pepper over.

recipes.name: Smoked mackerel potato salad
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; halve.
Blanch beans 3 min.
Flake mackerel over; dress with mustard, oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Minestrone soup
steps: Soften onion, carrot, zucchini in oil.
Add tomatoes, stock, beans and 1.5 L water; simmer 20 min.
Add pasta, cook 10 min more.
Finish with oregano and pepper.

recipes.name: Mushroom risotto
steps: Fry mushrooms hard; set aside.
Soften onion and garlic; toast the rice.
Add stock a ladle at a time, 18 min.
Beat in butter, parmesan, mushrooms.

recipes.name: Overnight oats with apple
steps: Stir oats, chia and milk together.
Layer with grated apple and yogurt.
Chill overnight.

recipes.name: Paneer jalfrezi
steps: Fry paneer cubes; set aside.
Peppers with onion, garlic, ginger, spices.
Passata in; paneer back; 10 min.
Basmati alongside.

recipes.name: Smoked paprika popcorn
steps: Pop the kernels (lidded pot, medium heat).
Dress with oil, paprika, salt.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Pour and drink cold.

recipes.name: Peanut noodles with tofu
steps: Soak noodles in boiling water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime into a sauce.
Fry tofu; toss everything with shredded carrot and pepper.

recipes.name: Pork and apple tray bake
steps: Oven 200C. Pork and potatoes in oil.
Apples and sage around; cider poured in.
Roast 40 min; rest before slicing.

recipes.name: Yogurt protein pancakes
steps: Blitz oats, eggs, yogurt, baking powder.
Fry small pancakes 2 min a side.
Maple over.

recipes.name: Red lentil curry
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger in a little oil.
Toast the spices; add lentils, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer 25 min until lentils collapse; wilt in spinach.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Rice cakes with avocado
steps: Mash the avocado with lemon.
Spread on the corn cakes; chili over.

recipes.name: Roast chicken salad
steps: Roast the thighs 35 min at 200C; cool and slice.
Toss leaves, avocado, cucumber.
Top with chicken; dress with lemon and oil.

recipes.name: Lemon roast chicken tray bake
steps: Oven 210C. Potatoes and lemon wedges in the oil and oregano.
Chicken on top, skin up; 40 min.
Beans under the tray for the last 8 min.

recipes.name: Smoky roasted chickpeas
steps: Drain and dry the chickpeas well.
Toss with oil and spices.
Roast 30 min at 200C until crisp.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion and pepper in oil with the spices.
Add tomatoes; simmer 10 min.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until just set.
Crumble feta and parsley over.

recipes.name: Shrimp garlic pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti; keep a cup of water.
Sizzle garlic and chili in oil; add shrimp 3 min.
Toss with pasta, water, lemon, parsley.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon rye toast
steps: Toast the rye bread.
Spread cream cheese, layer salmon.
Finish with dill and lemon.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Soffritto: carrot, celery, onion in oil, 10 min.
Add garlic, mince; brown.
Tomatoes, paste, oregano; simmer 40 min.
Cook spaghetti; parmesan on top.

recipes.name: Sweet potato black bean tacos
steps: Oven 210C. Sweet potato wedges in spices.
Warm the beans.
Load tortillas; avocado, pickled onion, lime.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon rice bowl
steps: Roast salmon 12 min at 200C, glazed with teriyaki.
Steam edamame; cook rice.
Bowl: rice, flaked salmon, edamame, cucumber, sesame.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken curry
steps: Fry the paste until fragrant.
Add chicken; seal.
Pour in coconut milk; simmer 15 min with pepper and beans.
Season with fish sauce; basil over rice.

recipes.name: Savory tofu scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu.
Fry spring onion greens in oil, add tofu and turmeric.
Scramble 5 min, season.

recipes.name: Turkey club sandwich
steps: Cook the turkey mince with salt and pepper.
Toast the bread; spread mayo.
Stack turkey, cheese, lettuce, tomato; skewer.

recipes.name: Three-egg veggie omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs.
Soften pepper and spinach in an oiled pan.
Add eggs, cook gently, cheese on top, fold.

recipes.name: Veggie tofu stir-fry
steps: Press and cube the tofu; fry until crisp.
Stir-fry the veg with garlic and ginger.
Add soy; toss; serve over rice.
